1925, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 24
June 1st Despairing of Employment - is offered Excellent work. Mr. Edw'd Kennedy 32 - 4447 Lemay Ave. out of work with his big truck since November with wife and two children is enrolled May 14th gets ex- cellent job unexpectedly before week-end. $2.40 per hour. Thanks
3rd Leakage of Heart Mrs. Cora Norkowski 45 - 2969 Baldwin Ave. hopelessly weak in action of heart; Daughter home from Sault St. Marys - 455 miles - on telegram - call since this A.M. Enrolled this evening for year.
7th Spinalmegitis Averted. Betty Ann Beaudon 3 yrs. Windsor Ont. Scarlet-fever threatening Enrolled a week ago to-day, is now sitting up and quite out of danger.
June 14th Seven-Year Estrangement. Mr. & Mrs., B. and A. Monaghan (57 & 42) ( 1941 Taylor Ave. ) Estranged for seven years are enrolled in S.M. Assoc. To-day, by unhappy Mrs.
June 20th Cancer Cured. Hector Combs 19 yrs old, 2714 National Ave, En- rolled March 1st after doctring for peculialy sore - leg since January 1922 - always getting worse till inrollment. To-day re- ports entirely healed. Thanks be to God. - ec'pt little paroxide.
June 24 Goirter Cured, Mrs. Matilda Reno 67 of 7936 LaFayette West, suffer- ing from goirter for about 15 yrs, was beginning to deprive her of sleep, etc., very anxious was enrolled in S.M.A. March 27. To-day reports quite cured - entirely disappeared. Deo Gr!
25 Leo Krivick 22, 4479 Cadalic, Overcome by heat. and unconscius for 5 days is enrolled June 11th To-day reported as having recovered almost imediately after enrollment gets up same day and shaves. Deo Gratias
26 Nose gone by 15-yr-Canser. Tobert Patrick Carey, 68, 452 Meldrum Ave, fighting cancer on his nose since 1909, using Anna Rita 10 months which usually cures such maladies, is enrolled To-day for 2 yrs
28 Hopless Consumptive. Mrs. Margaret Harrington Phillips Ave DetroitEnrolled 5.10 p.m. To-day
